capabilities: Suggest tags from a saved registry using an OpenAI-compatible model
Review suggestions and append or replace frontmatter tags
Import, add, search and persist allowed tags in a registry
Rename or delete a tag across the vault after confirmation
Build and refresh a cached tag semantic library
extras: API key is stored in plaintext in the plugin's data.json; vault-wide rename and delete are not transactional, so the README advises backing up first. No telemetry or author-operated backend.
problem: Model-generated tags can be arbitrary or invented, with no built-in way to keep them inside a trusted tag set or review them before they reach a note.

relations.evidence: SiliconFlow presets plus custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and model IDs
Install the Obsidian community plugin BRAT.

summary: AI tag suggester that limits an OpenAI-compatible model to a saved tag registry and requires review before writing frontmatter tags.
